papers.title: DataPrep-Bench: Benchmarking LLMs as Training Data Preparators
papers.desc: The first unified benchmark for how well LLMs, agents, and data-centric workflows actually prepare training data end to end.

papers.title: Molt: A Scalable PyTorch-Native Training Framework for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.desc: A PyTorch-native framework that cuts the cost of changing algorithms, estimators, and rollout schemes in agentic RL research.

papers.title: Agentic Context Management: Solving Agent Memory and Cost by Treating Them as Lifecycle and Architecture Problems
papers.desc: Argues production agents fail less from poor reasoning than from drowning in their own accumulating context, and treats memory as an architecture problem.

papers.title: Interactive Training 2: Auditable Control Plane for Live Model Training
papers.desc: An open-source control plane for steering a live training run through a shared protocol instead of trainer-specific code.

papers.title: Scaling Native Multimodal Pre-Training From Scratch
papers.desc: Trains models on multimodal inputs from scratch rather than bolting perception onto a text-only pretrained base.

papers.title: Three-Body Scattering for Generative Modeling
papers.desc: A distributional energy induces sample-level motion, giving direct regression supervision for a one-step generator with no adversarial critic or prescribed noise path.

papers.title: O-VAD: Industrial Video Anomaly Detection through Object-Centric Tracking and Reasoning
papers.desc: Object-centric tracking plus reasoning to catch anomalous objects and events in industrial processes.

papers.title: LAMAR: An Open Language-Aware Multilingual Alignment Reranker
papers.desc: A reranker that accounts for document language when ordering results in multilingual retrieval-augmented generation.

papers.title: Multi-Head Latent Control: A Unified Interface for LLM Agent Decision Making
papers.desc: One interface lets an agent decide at inference time whether to continue reasoning, defer to a stronger model, or request more information.

papers.title: Closing the Loop: Training-Free Revisit Consistency for Autoregressive Generative Rendering
papers.desc: Keeps long-horizon autoregressive video generation consistent when revisiting a scene, without extra training.

papers.title: IDEAgent: Agentic Quality-Diversity Search for Research Idea Generation
papers.desc: Optimizes research ideas for quality and diversity together, rather than collapsing into variations on one theme.

papers.title: SceneActBench: Can Agents Act on the 3D Scenes They See?
papers.desc: A benchmark for VLM agents that use tools to act on complete multi-object 3D scenes, not just describe them.

papers.title: Spectral Prior for Reducing Exposure Bias in Diffusion Models
papers.desc: Identifies frequency-dependent train/inference mismatch as a driver of diffusion exposure bias and corrects for it.

papers.title: VisCo: Leveraging Large Language Models as Intrinsic Encoders for Visual Token Compression
papers.desc: Uses the language model itself as the encoder to compress visual tokens, cutting VLM latency and memory overhead.

papers.title: Multimodal Speaker Verification as a Threat to Speaker Anonymization
papers.desc: Shows that accumulating acoustic, prosodic, and linguistic cues across many utterances undermines speaker anonymization.
